**Discpress 1.3.9 closes the last items from the full review of the app**, and reads more kinds of disc images correctly.

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.3.9/discpress.html)** (about 3 MB): the whole app in one file you keep.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad.

## Disc images read correctly

- **Nero images (.nrg)** keep the pregaps they store, and tracks after one are no longer shifted. The CHD is now the same as from a cue sheet of the same disc.
- **cdrdao TOC files (.toc)** are read the way cdrdao writes them: START, PREGAP, SILENCE and ZERO, several files in one track, and a file without a length (the rest of it). Such TOCs used to be refused, or gave a CHD with the wrong layout.
- **EAC cue sheets with "gaps appended to the previous track"** (a track's pregap at the end of the previous file) make the right CHD.
- **A raw .iso of 2,352-byte sectors** is recognized whatever its size (some sizes were taken for 2,048-byte images in the Advanced tab).
- **Extracting a CD CHD as a DVD** in the Advanced tab is an error instead of a meaningless file.
- **Extracting a CD as a TOC file** gives a TOC that converts back to the very same CHD. The TOC of a disc with pregaps changes by one line: chdman 0.289 added a `ZERO` line that made the disc longer when converted back.
- **TOC files naming `.wav` audio** read it as WAV (without the file's header), and data ending inside a sector is padded with zeros, as cdrdao does.
- **Damaged audio in a CHD** is reported cleanly (an arithmetic overflow in the audio decoder is gone; results are unchanged).

## Identification

- **A CHD made against a parent CHD** is identified through its parent.
- **PlayStation discs that boot `PSX.EXE`** get their serial number from the disc.
- **NAOMI 2** GD-ROMs are named with their right system.
- **A damaged ECM image** found while checking against the database says so on its card, before you convert it.

## Saving and other fixes

- **Cancel works while the last writes into a folder are going** ("Saving to folder"), and a job that crashes leaves no half-written file.
- **Notifications:** Settings → "Notify me when all jobs are done" (asks your browser's permission).
- **Download all** reminds you to allow the browser's "several downloads" prompt.
- **Two open tabs** no longer lose each other's list of unsaved results.
- **The speed test** pauses a game's checksum while it measures (the checksum starts over after it), so it no longer settles on fewer threads.
- **Advanced tab:** typed commands accept backslash escapes (`my\ game.cue`).

Valid cue sheets, GDIs, ISOs and CHDs give the same CHDs as before. Nero images and TOC files with pregaps, and EAC sheets with appended gaps, give different (correct) CHDs, and TOC files extracted from discs with pregaps lose one wrong line.
